This is how dropshipping actually works: First, you create your online store. You can do this with Shopify for $1/month. I also recommend connecting it to pagepilot.ai so you can just have AI design the store for you. Next, you sign up for Zendrop and link it to Shopify. Zendrop is your supplier. Essentially, they stock the product you're selling on your store. Then, when somebody buys the product on your store, Zendrop is notified, and they package up the product and ship it to your customer. You don't have to touch the product once. This way, you don't have to spend thousands buying a bunch of inventory. You only pay Zendrop once the customer has paid you first. #ecom #entrepreneur #business #shopify #onlinebusiness

Here's a quick explanation of what Dropshipping is and how it all works... #dropshipping #shopifydropshipping #dropshippingproducts #dropshippingtips #dropshippingbrasil

Dropshipping is the process of listing products online, waiting for customers to purchase the product, using the customer’s money to purchase the product from your vendor, then having your vendor ship the product directly to your customer while you keep the remainder of the profit. Buying inventory is one of the biggest struggles small business owners face when trying to get their businesses off the ground. For this reason, I recommend starting off with dropshipping. This is how I earned thousands of dollars without investing thousands of dollars. Click link in bio to buy 40 Vendors list + ebook for $35! Use code: FLASH 🥰🥰 -  DISCLAIMER: I ONLY HAVE THE PRODUCT IN MY POSSESSION ON THIS VIDEO BECAUSE I HAD THE VENDOR SHIP IT TO ME FIRST SO I CAN MAKE CONTENT. During dropshipping you usually won’t physically touch the product that you are selling. -— *  First I listed my products online on a shopify website. Before doing this you’ll need to develop a pricelist to make sure you are receiving your desired profit after buying the product from the vendor. Don’t have a reliable dropshipping vendor? Check out my personal vendors on my website! • For my website product pictures, l used pictures online from google and edited my logo into the picture until I was able to have an actual photoshoot for my products. (WHEN DOING THIS MAKE SURE YOU FIND PICTURES THAT DOESN’T HAVE ANOTHER COMPANY’S LOGO VISIBLE! THIS IS FOR COPYRIGHT REASONS) Since you won’t have the product on hand yet, I recommend buying one sample of the product to be able to advertise so customers can see it is in your possession. For example, I bought one 18” bundle and advertised that in many videos until I received my first order. I also bought a wig from my vendor and installed it in a video to promote that to customers as well. •Once you receive your first order have the vendor ship it to you first to create content then ship it back out to your customer for around $8-$15.
